title: Template defaults for hits
body:
Right now, you can't use the hits widget without actually passing a template for both the results and empty results. We could have `'No results` for empty and `function(h){return '
'+JSON.stringify(h, null, 2)+'
';}` for the result. It's not ideal but let the user start immediately.

comments.body: There's now a default template which is `hit: 'Object #{{objectID}}, this is the default`hits`template, you should provide one'`, JSON.stringify would be interesting.
I'm working on a cleanup of the hits widget, I'll add this as well.
